text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Uwaaah?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I've l-lost... lost... lost!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Did I just... lose?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It can't be?! But... I'm the talented class

representative?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: NOOOO! That just can't be!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: B-but this is reality. I have lost...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Perhaps the truth is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That I'm not talented?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's true! I can't run long
distances, just
like everyone says! No,
no, no! There's simply no
way, I... the...
the class representative...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
W-wait, does that make me... no longer
class
representative?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If I can't be looked up to by the people,
then I
can't fulfill my role as class
representative...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, anything but that! If I'm not class

representative, then I have nothing left!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then who am I?!
Wellhellotherehowdoyoudo?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Are you Sakura Bakushin O?! An
Umamusume
soon to be class
representative?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...Come down?! You tell me I should
come down
in rank?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Breath in...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...and out.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the air here is delicious... even
though we are
underground.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's finally calmed down, but the shock
of losing
is still hitting hard. If that's the
case...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: A step in the process...
choice_data_list: 今はまだ、君は成長過程なんだ
今はまだ、貴方は成長過程なんだよ
choice_data_list_en: Right now, you're still in the middle of growing.
You're still in the process of growing right now, you know.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's true! I've still got a long way to
go!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This doesn't mean I've failed. I just need
more
practice!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, for a second I forgot how
wonderful of an
Umamusume I am. Silly
me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...It's good that she bounces back so
quickly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I will pull myself together! So
please, tell
me what to do!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I believe that the objectively best
measure here
would be to follow your
advice.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No matter the situation, I am a perfect,
honest,
and well-behaved class
representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes!
choice_data_list: じゃあ鍛えなおそう！短距離で！
choice_data_list_en: Then let's retrain! For short distances!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wait, sprinting?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, now that I think about it, you're
right!
choice_data_list: 必要なのは更なるスピードだから！
choice_data_list_en: Because what we need is even more speed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We'll be dropping a grade, but if there's
a race
she can definitely win, it's a
1,200-meter race.
choice_data_list: じゃあ、次は『葵ステークス』を走ろう！
choice_data_list_en: Then let's run the Aoi Stakes next!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I understand. I will give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I will restore my hurt pride as class
representative!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, it's settled. The next race will be
the Aoi
Stakes!
